preamble: The alveolar trill [r] can be replaced by the voiceless velar fricative [x]. In Singkil (Aceh, Indonesia) the /r/ of Indonesian corresponds to [x] in all positions, and Singkil speakers carry this into Indonesian as an identity marker. In most of Brazil the Portuguese 'strong r', originally an alveolar trill, is usually pronounced [x].

examples.from: strong r (rr, initial r), originally an alveolar trill [r], e.g. carro 'car', rosa 'rose'
examples.note: The strong r is usually pronounced as a voiceless velar fricative in Brazil; [h] and [χ] also occur, while the trill survives in parts of Portugal and in Africa and Asia.
